title: Kill Bots Picks
heading: Picks: the ending's big moment, and the kill-bots rounds
intro: Round 1 picks are saved and in hand. Press Pick on one option per line or cue; add a note if none is right. Picks save as you go. Nobody has listened to any of this yet. Tell Claude when you're done.

sections.h: Round 3: the boss, your new words
sections.lede: Line 1 (your pick, w10 take 1) and chase cue C3 (w60 take 2) are now recorded. Lines 2–4 re-made with your words, four takes each. Open on Suno, listen, pick one per line. Nobody has listened yet.

groups.title: The boss, line 2
groups.line: Oh. And they've activated their firewalls.

groups.title: The boss, line 3
groups.line: No, thank you, Maddie. I will handle it.

groups.title: The boss, line 4

sections.h: The boss, one line at a time
sections.lede: Your note: do each line on its own. Four takes per line; pick the cleanest read of each (a line can come from any take). Open on Suno and listen; only your picks get recorded.

groups.title: The boss, line 1
groups.line: Maddie, are you making fun of my simulations again?

groups.title: The boss, line 2
groups.line: Oh. Oh, wow. And they've activated their firewalls.

groups.title: The boss, line 3
groups.line: No. I've got it.

groups.title: The boss, line 4
groups.line: Phew. Glad I kept that little exploit up my sleeve.

sections.lede: Your note: the last ones were too happy. Two new, very different dark cues. Pick one take (or none, with a note).

groups.title: Chase and call (9a-12), style C3
groups.line: Relentless low-string ostinato: two cellos, double bass, tremolo violins, raw and close. Breaks off to one held low note.

groups.title: Chase and call (9a-12), style C4
groups.line: A lone piano hammering in its lowest octaves, tremolo violin, cello drone, a vast cold hall. Stops dead, leaves the tremolo.

sections.lede: Re-made 9b and your two beat-1 stills animated. The 9a pass from S11-C failed (the bot clipped her), so the existing pass stays.

groups.title: Maddie in the dust, re-made (9b)
groups.line: We open inside the bot's dust wake and it settles fast; she never moves. A: Veo from a dust-buried still (opens hazy, not opaque). B: the same with an extra dust layer so it opens nearly opaque and clears by ~1.5 s (Claude's pick; risk: flat fog, not billowing).

groups.title: Patrol from your still S11-C (beat 1)
groups.line: The bot prowls down from the tower, turret sweeping, dust behind; Maddie stays still. Note: a long gun barrel shows side-on at ~5 s.

groups.title: Two bots under the rail arch, from your still S12-D (beat 1)
groups.line: Two bots come through the rusted arch; the front one prowls up to camera, scanning the shopfronts.
